explication: ExplorerPatcher modifies the Windows shell to provide a configurable, Windows 10-style desktop experience. The documented user flow is installation, opening taskbar Properties, and selecting taskbar, Start menu, window-switcher, or other options; the resident patcher applies shell changes. The README also documents built-in updates and uninstall. The tree and excerpts show additional weather-flyout and settings UI components. Several feature implementations were not sampled, so links from the patcher to those subsystems are shown as unverified rather than asserted as confirmed calls.
